summary.headline: Venus and Marriage Judgments
summary.text: Astrological judgments on Venus in a nativity: her conjunctions, aspects, houses, exaltation, orientation, retrogradation, combustion, and relation to Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, Mercury, the Moon, and the Sun determine lust, betrothal, marriage, social status, and affection between spouses.
